verdict: Yes, if you understand delivery apps. Dil Foods from Ranchi pitched a virtual restaurant service on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from four sharks. Virtual brands let existing restaurants use spare kitchen capacity, so you can grow without opening your own kitchens.
angle: Many restaurants have idle kitchen time outside peak hours. A virtual brand operator supplies recipes, sauces and branding, and partner restaurants cook and deliver. Delivery-app ratings and consistent food quality decide success.
